settings.title: Settings
settings.timezoneHint: Day buckets and range presets use this zone. Changing it rebuilds every daily aggregate.
settings.serverWarning: The headless server has no login. Binding it to a non-loopback address exposes the dashboard to anyone who can reach this port.
settings.scanRootsHint: Extra directories to read in addition to each harness's default location.
settings.runReportHint: What each harness contributed, and where it was read from.
settings.pricingHint: Rates are USD per million tokens. A reported cost from the harness always wins over a table rate.
settings.rulesHint: Per-model multipliers, and a switch to exclude a model from cost totals entirely.
settings.deleteDataHint: Removes every stored event and aggregate. Session files are never modified, so the next scan rebuilds them.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete every stored event and aggregate? The next scan will rebuild from the session files.
settings.sleepHint: Prevents idle sleep for the selected options while an agent process is running and its session was written recently. Sleeps after the delay only when the keyboard and mouse are idle. On macOS, manual Sleep remains available unless a legacy setting disables it.
settings.sleepOffHint: The app does not prevent idle sleep; the operating system's power settings apply. On macOS, manual Sleep remains available unless a legacy setting disables it.
settings.sleepAlwaysHint: Continuously prevents idle sleep for the selected options while the app is running, even without agent activity. Does not automatically put the machine to sleep. On macOS, manual Sleep remains available unless a legacy setting disables it.
settings.sleepNoTargets: No sleep prevention targets are selected.
settings.preventLidClosedSleep: Keep running with the lid closed
settings.lidHint: Lid-closed sleep prevention is not supported here. Closing the lid follows the operating system's power settings. On macOS, manual Sleep remains available unless a legacy setting disables it.
settings.lidPrivateNotice: Best-effort private lid control. Manual Sleep remains available; switching AC power may sleep the Mac. Turning this off or quitting with the lid closed may immediately allow sleep. This policy is shared with powerd: avoid another lid manager. The guardian reduces, but cannot guarantee, crash cleanup.
settings.lidPrivateCompact: Private shared lid control · best effort
settings.lidManualWarning: Manual Sleep remains available; switching AC power may sleep the Mac
settings.lidReleaseWarning: Turning off or quitting with the lid closed may immediately allow sleep
settings.lidGuardianWarning: Shared with powerd; avoid another lid manager. Guardian cannot guarantee crash cleanup
settings.clamshellActive: A previous version or external setting has disabled all sleep system-wide, including Sleep from the Apple menu. Restore system sleep to undo it; restoration may require an administrator password.
settings.statusLegacySleepDisabled: System sleep is disabled; restore it
settings.sleepUnsupported: Sleep control is not supported on this platform.
settings.statusWaitingUser: Waiting for the user to step away
settings.rebuilt: Rebuilt daily aggregates for the new timezone.
